description: Knights Corner x100 core timing in core cycles: instruction latencies, pairing rules, unit occupancies, cache hit latencies, store and gather rules, TLB and L2-prefetcher parameters. Measured or derived on the GCC-KNC project's 7120-class card (S6-03, S8-01, S8-12, S12-31). Every x100 model (3120, 5110P, 7120) uses the same core design, so card profiles inherit this layer; on a card other than the 7120 the values are transferred, not re-measured there.

latency.mask_op.source: S6-03 kand.lat 2.08 bounds it at <=2; 1 assumed like scalar

latency.vector_arith.source: S6-03 vaddps.lat 4.02, vmulps.lat 4.03, vfmadd213ps.lat 4.02, vpaddd.lat 4.03, vpxord.lat 4.03, vaddpd/vmulpd/vfmadd213pd 4.03, vcvtfxpntdq2ps/ps2dq 4.03
latency.vector_arith.applies_to: all vector arithmetic, logic, SP/DP FMA and dq<->ps conversions

latency.vector_long.applies_to: permutes, swizzles, vrcp23ps; vrsqrt23ps/vlog2ps/vexp223ps assumed in the same class (not measured)

latency.scalar_load_l1.uncertainty: R08 and R17 slides 13-14 (whose wording differs) document 1 (or 2) cycles.

latency.vector_load_l1.unit: cycles, L1 hit plain vector load to dependent use
latency.vector_load_l1.source: S6-03 spill_reload.lat 12.11 = store-to-load path (7, from c9.memory.u1) + load-to-use; R08 documents 3 for vector loads
latency.vector_load_l1.uncertainty: not isolated by a native row (a dependent plain vector-load chain is a native request candidate); 3 would make the spill/reload chain 10

latency.l2_hit.source: S6-03 l2.load_lat 24.42 (one thread), 25.68 at four threads
latency.l2_hit.uncertainty: R17 slide 14 documents 11 raw cycles; literature (R06, R08) measures 22-25.

latency.agi_cycles.source: S6-03 agi.gap0 3.11 vs 2.08 baseline at one thread: the dependent load issued one cycle after its earliest slot, i.e. address usable 3 cycles after the write issued; R01 p.19

latency.branch_mispredict_penalty.unit: cycles per branch in the pseudorandom test
latency.branch_mispredict_penalty.source: S8-01 C10: 11.27 vs 6.22 ticks per branch at one thread (difference 5.05)
latency.branch_mispredict_penalty.uncertainty: The test did not separate the miss rate; if half the branches missed, the penalty per miss is about 10. The model charges this value per branch the scenario marks mispredicted.

latency.branch_taken_bubble.source: S8-01 C9: loop costs about 2 ticks per vector op plus 2 per loop branch at one thread (the branch costs its issue slot only)

latency.scalar_imul.source: R02 p.56; not measured on this card by the imported runs

latency.x87_div.source: S6-03 x87_div.lat 39.25, .rt 38.24; one divide per 38 cycles per core at four threads

occupancy.x87_mul.source: S6-03 x87_mul.rt 4.02 per thread at two threads (one per 2 cycles per core)

occupancy.x87_div.source: S6-03 x87_div.rt 151.76 per thread at four threads (37.9 per core)

latency.gather_first_line.source: S6-03 gather_all.lat 15.10 per kmov/vpord/gather/jknzd link minus the vpord (4.02): the gathered data is ready 11 cycles after the gather issues. 0.2.x used 15, which counted the vpord twice.

occupancy.gather_cycles_per_line.source: S6-03 gather_all.rt 7.08 per gather at one thread, 7.02 per core at four; gather_scattered (16 lines) 127 per core
occupancy.gather_cycles_per_line.uncertainty: 16 lines measured 127 per core, more than 16 x 7 = 112; the per-line figure is optimistic for scattered gathers.
occupancy.gather_cycles_per_line.note: One cache line per gather execution (numerical_policy.gather_completion one_line): a re-executed gather also waits for the previous execution's data because the lanes merge into the destination (S6-03 gather_scattered.rt 175.14 = 16 x 11).

occupancy.vprefetch_l2_core_cycles.source: S8-01 C2: vprefetch1 4.52 per thread at two threads, 9.01 at four (about 2.25 per core); modeled as 2 (integer cycles)
occupancy.vprefetch_l2_core_cycles.uncertainty: 2.25 measured; the integer model understates by about 11%.

latency.spill_reload_chain.unit: cycles for a store followed by a dependent reload

latency.store_to_load_same_line.unit: cycles after a store issues before a load of the same line sees the data
latency.store_to_load_same_line.source: S8-12 C9 memory chain u1 11.07 per link = folded-load add (4) + store-to-load path; spill_reload.lat 12.11 = path + plain load (5)

latency.x87_move.source: evidence E (estimate), inferred: same pipeline as the measured x87 add (S6-03 x87_add.lat 3.02), no KNC source for fld/fst/fxch/fldz; fld from memory uses the load latency instead
latency.x87_move.uncertainty: fxch may be cheaper; not measured

latency.x87_compare.source: assumed equal to the measured x87 add latency

tlb.l1_entries_4k.source: S8-12 C4 rerun (2026-11-08): loads cost L1 latency up to 64 4 KiB pages per core and about 29 ticks more beyond

tlb.l1_miss_penalty_cycles.source: S8-12 C4 rerun: 31.76-31.79 vs 3.01-3.02 ticks per load at one thread

latency.vector_load_merge_l1.source: S6-03 masked_load.lat, masked_load_sparse.lat, convert_up.lat and convert_down.lat all equal spill_reload.lat (12.11): no measurable extra cost for the merge or conversion form

l1.store_miss_stalls_context.source: S6-03 l2.store_normal 23.39 ticks per store at one thread (an L2-resident footprint): each store waits for its line; R08's 'except store misses' does not hold for this card/pattern

store.nr_stall_cycles_resident.unit: cycles per vmovnr* store, cache-resident line, per context

store.nr_stall_cycles_memory.unit: cycles per vmovnr* store to a non-resident line, per context

store.nr_occupancy_core_cycles.source: S6-03 l1.store_stream 36.16 per thread at four threads / 4

l2.hw_prefetch_depth_lines.source: S6-03 memory.load_rt 37.35 ticks per sequential line at one thread with the hardware prefetcher active: the HWP sub-model reproduces 37.4 with depth 16 (40.2 at 12, 51.4 at 8); at four threads it gives 85.5 against 77.9 (see references/validation.md)

latency.gather_mask_cycles.source: S6-03 gather_all.rt 7.08 per kmov/gather/jknzd unit: the completion-mask branch issues long before the 15-cycle data latency; 2 reproduces the row together with the 7-cycle gather unit occupancy

pairing.x87_pairs_with_scalar.source: S12-31 microbench, card windows 3 and 5 (2026-11-15): moving faddp out from between cmp and jg saves one issue per iteration (adj_0 and mid_0 -44.8/-45.6 ns per 27-product row, 1.66 ns per iteration); an x87 instruction issues alone

pairing.v_nop_pairs.source: S12-31 microbench window 5: fifteen single-byte NOPs before the loop cost 22.7 ns per row, 1.51 ns (one issue) each; S6-03 agi.gap1-4 for the U side

pairing.load_store_pair.source: S6-03 spill_reload.rt at four threads: 1.07 core cycles per vector store plus reload, so a U-pipe load and a V-pipe store issue in one cycle; the L1 access limit is applied to loads only

store.load_after_store_interlock_cycles.unit: cycles after a store before the same context may issue a load
store.load_after_store_interlock_cycles.source: S6-03 spill_reload.rt 4.20/4.26 per pair at two/four threads and S8-12 C9 memory chains u2/u4 8.56/8.30 per link at one thread (two issues plus four cycles); vector rows only, applied to scalar stores as well (assumed)
store.load_after_store_interlock_cycles.uncertainty: spill_reload.rt at one thread measures 5.09, one cycle more than this rule gives; the two-thread C9 memory rows (12.03, 11.01) are 3 to 4 cycles above it
store.load_after_store_interlock_cycles.note: calibration rows: spill_reload.rt (2, 4 threads), c9.memory.u2, c9.memory.u4 (1 thread)

frontend.taken_branch_core_bubble_cycles.unit: core issue cycles lost after a taken branch
frontend.taken_branch_core_bubble_cycles.source: S8-01 C10 fixed-direction row: 6.22 per branch at one thread, 17.02 at four (three issues plus about one core cycle per unit); R02 ch.4 one-clock refill bubble. Hidden at one thread by the same-context spacing. Scope: forward transfers only (S8-01 C9 register chains at two threads show no cost for the loop back-edge).
frontend.taken_branch_core_bubble_cycles.note: calibration rows: c10.branch.fixed (4 threads) for the value; c9.vector.u1/u2/u4 (2 threads: 4.02/3.01/2.51 per update, no cycle lost per iteration) for the scope: forward taken branches, calls and returns only, not loop back-edges

x87.mem_operand_serializes.source: S12-31 microbench (card windows 3 and 5): the row loop costs two cycles per issue plus a constant whatever follows fmull (faddp directly, or add and cmp first), so the instructions after an x87 memory-operand instruction do not issue while it completes

latency.x87_load.unit: cycles from issue until the loaded value is on the x87 stack
latency.x87_load.source: S12-31 gas_0 488.9 and adj_0 433.5 cycles per 27-product row fix the sum of this value and the fmull memory form (operand read plus multiply) at 7 cycles; the split 3 + (1 + 3) keeps the measured x87 multiply latency of 3 and the documented one-cycle scalar load (R08)

latency.x87_mem_operand_load.unit: cycles for the memory operand of an x87 arithmetic instruction before the operation starts
latency.x87_mem_operand_load.source: see latency.x87_load: the sum is measured, the split is assumed (R08: one-cycle scalar load)
latency.x87_mem_operand_load.uncertainty: only the sum with latency.x87_load is measured
